purpose: Illustrated Ink replay segmentation and prompt controls for a 2092 contract dispute among a Horizon freight-habitat crew, Tactical Solutions International, and lunar shipping underwriters.

visual_scene_plan.purpose: Click-through visual anchors for ordinary galley work, four preparatory choices, the C-12 alarm, management arrival, incident classification, insurer review, and four ending families.
visual_scene_plan.segmentation_rule: Use separate visual_scene_id anchors for the empty-room orientation, inhabited breakfast routine, each ordinary-life branch, the folded serving line, the C-12 alarm and authority entrance, the incident choice, the insurer call, the final evidence threshold, and each ending family. The amber alarm and Yara Dast's appearance each receive a new frame because they change the room's power geometry.
visual_scene_plan.prompting_rule: Each base image prompt repeats the visible room geometry, lighting, materials, interfaces, and full appearance of every visible named character or group. Prompt assembly adds the global style cue plus only the visual refs for characters visible in that frame and any triggered state or branch modifiers.
visual_scene_plan.global_style_cue: Style: bleak corporate science-fiction editorial illustration, restrained ink lines and matte gouache color, bruised amber and desaturated teal palette, tactile worn metal and cheap polymer, cinematic staging with readable interactive-fiction silhouettes, humane faces, precise institutional absurdity, practical work grime.
visual_scene_plan.prompt_assembly_rule: Assemble each image prompt from the global_style_cue, the complete scene base_image_prompt, visual refs only for visible named characters or groups, and triggered state_image_modifiers or global_branch_image_modifiers. Keep visual_continuity_notes in reviewer tooling. Use the draft scene_set camera and staging slots as geometry authority for every angle.

scene_set_guidance.scope_reason: The fixture returns to one galley from several angles and uses sightlines, doors, badge custody, an archive dock, and a hot soup pot as branch-relevant geometry. A draft plan map is included to hold those relations.
scene_set_guidance.future_scene_set_need: Before high-consistency website rendering, turn the draft map into a simple 3D blockout with the curved outer-hull floor, forward serving counter, port maintenance door and status panel, aft TSI booth, starboard management vestibule, six tables, roster reader, and fixed camera slots.

scenes.base_image_prompt: Wide empty-room establishing frame inside a compact freight-habitat galley at Earth–Luna L1. The rectangular room is twelve meters long and eight meters wide, with a subtly curved dark rubberized floor following the rotating wheel's outer hull and a low ribbed metal ceiling. Six bolted rectangular tables occupy the center aisle. A stainless serving counter and soup warmer run along the forward bulkhead. The port bulkhead holds a sealed industrial maintenance door and a wide hull-status panel of teal equipment diagrams. The aft bulkhead contains a two-chair counseling booth behind frosted glass, with a small locked archive dock beside it. The starboard bulkhead contains a clean management vestibule and a waist-high roster badge reader. Amber strip lights, teal screens, patched gray wall panels, stacked cups, ration sleeves, and exposed fasteners make the room practical, worn, and tightly owned.
visual_continuity_notes: Local gravity points toward the curved floor. Forward, aft, port, and starboard remain stable plan directions.
The serving counter, port maintenance door, hull-status panel, aft TSI booth, starboard vestibule, roster reader, table three, and soup pot keep fixed positions.
